item.title: European Commission Proposes Treaty Change to End Unanimity in Foreign Policy
item.description: The proposal would abolish veto rights and move the European Union to qualified majority voting, a transfer of sovereignty member states have long resisted.

item.title: EU Defense Union Gains Support After Summit
item.description: Leaders in Brussels backed the defense union framework including a joint European army command structure.

item.title: EU Agricultural Subsidy Report Published
item.description: The annual report on farm subsidies across the European Union was released.
